hero_desc_zh: 火红长发，黑铁鎏金符文战甲，火焰光晕环绕周身，面颊符文发光，以烈焰为武器（火焰冲击波、熔岩爆炸、烈焰横扫）

opponent.desc_zh: 由黑冰与寒雾构成的亡灵剑士，双眼透出冰蓝寒光，刃上拖曳霜雾
opponent.desc_en: undead swordsman of black ice and freezing mist, ice-blue glowing eyes, frost trailing off its blade

environment.desc_en: ruined overgrown city, collapsed towers swallowed by vines and deep moss
environment.desc_zh: 被藤蔓与厚苔吞没的废墟之城，坍塌的高塔残骸

delivery_check.question: Does the video OPEN on a high-intensity action beat in the first ~2 seconds — the hero already mid-action with an energy burst/detonation hurling enemies outward — rather than a slow establishing or build-up shot?
